selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency structure. The mining tasks (yellow_concrete_powder and red_sand) serve as prerequisite activities that require the player to first craft an iron_shovel (which is efficient for mining powder/sand materials). The snow_block crafting requires snowballs, which are obtained by using a shovel on snow layers - connecting it to the iron_shovel craft. The dependency chain is: craft iron_shovel → mine yellow_concrete_powder, craft iron_shovel → mine red_sand, and craft iron_shovel → craft snow_block (since you need a shovel to collect snowballs from snow). This creates a fan-out pattern from the shovel crafting task.

edges.reason: Iron shovel is the optimal tool for mining concrete powder blocks quickly; needed to break the block efficiently
Iron shovel is required to efficiently mine red sand; without it the block breaks too slowly or drops nothing
Shovel is required to harvest snowballs from snow layers; snowballs are the ingredient for crafting snow_block

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted iron_shovel ends up in the player's inventory after crafting at the crafting table. The player starts with only iron_ingot and sticks, so any iron_shovel in inventory must have been crafted.

Uses inventory_has because mining yellow_concrete_powder drops itself as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player starts with no yellow_concrete_powder, so any in inventory must have been mined from the placed blocks.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_sand drops itself as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player starts with no red_sand, so any in inventory must have been mined from the placed blocks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted snow_block ends up in the player's inventory. Pre-placed snow_blocks in the scene do NOT drop snow_block items when mined without Silk Touch (they drop snowballs instead), so any snow_block in inventory must have been crafted from 4 snowballs at the crafting table.

scene_description: A compact open-air scene on a grass platform with four key elements: (1) a crafting table for making the iron shovel and snow block, (2) yellow concrete powder blocks to mine, (3) red sand blocks to mine, and (4) a snow layer area on snow blocks for harvesting snowballs. The player starts with iron ingot and sticks to craft the iron shovel first, then uses it to complete the remaining three tasks.
task_text: Craft an iron shovel using the crafting table, then use it to: mine the yellow concrete powder blocks, mine the red sand blocks, and dig snow layers to collect snowballs and craft a snow block.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin (0,0,0). Crafting table at (+2,0,+2) - close by for immediate use. Yellow concrete powder at (-3,0,+5) and (-4,0,+5) - forward-left. Red sand at (+5,0,-3) and (+5,0,-4) - right-behind. Snow platform (3x3 snow_blocks with snow layers on top) at (-6 to -4, 0-1, -5 to -3) - left-behind. All within 8 blocks of spawn. Iron shovel recipe: 1 iron ingot + 2 sticks in crafting table. Snow block recipe: 4 snowballs in crafting table. Snow layers drop 2 snowballs each when broken with shovel, so 9 layers = 18 snowballs = enough for 4+ snow blocks. Oak planks removed per CommonSenseAgent feedback.
